Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Class SimpleStoryGraphTool

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.StoryGraphTool
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.SimpleStoryGraphTool
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Task
Direct Known Subclasses:
Clean, Explain, RemoveDisconnected, RemoveDuplicates, RemoveUnexplained, RemoveUnused, Sort
public abstract class SimpleStoryGraphTool extends StoryGraphTool
A parent class for story graph tools that reads a story graph from file, performs an operation on that graph, and then write the graph back out to file.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
